mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_userchat ( cno, r_title, r_tag, leader, r_regdate, sch_date, enabled ) VALUES ( seq_cno.nextval, #{r_title}, #{r_tag}, #{leader}, SYSDATE, TO_DATE(#{sch_date}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), 1 )
mapper.select: SELECT uc.*, u1.name AS leader_name, u2.name AS member_name FROM tbl_userchat uc LEFT JOIN tbl_user u1 ON uc.leader = u1.uno LEFT JOIN tbl_user u2 ON uc.member = u2.uno ORDER BY uc.cno DESC

SELECT uc.*, u1.name AS leader_name, u2.name AS member_name FROM tbl_userchat uc LEFT JOIN tbl_user u1 ON uc.leader = u1.uno LEFT JOIN tbl_user u2 ON uc.member = u2.uno WHERE uc.r_tag = #{r_tag} ORDER BY uc.cno DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE tbl_userchat SET leader = member, member = null WHERE cno = #{cno}
